text:
maria: Heads-up: attempting prod roll of redwood/api v2026.03.15, but deploy-bot blocked because eu registry reported a missing blob in the manifest. Holding rollout. @sam @jen can you triage?

deploy-bot: publish failed for redwood/api:v2026.03.15 in eu-west-1. error=ECR_PROVENANCE_DIFF, detail=manifest references unknown layer sha256:7f4e..., build=6421abc

sam: Sounds like a replication lag for the arm64 layer or manifestlist ordering mismatch. I can check the eu replica and compare manifests.

maria: Primary shows linux/arm64 blob sha256:7f4e... present. eu returns 404 for that blob when resolving the manifest. Error: "manifest list references nonexistent layer sha256:7f4e..."

jen: Given the change window, propose a short-lived retag: v2026.03.15-rc1 pushed directly into eu to avoid cross-region replication race. Then cosign re-sign and run a eu canary. We'll call it out in release notes as transient.

sam: Plan: fetch manifest from primary, put-image with -rc1 into eu, cosign sign, then kick off canary. Anyone object?

kai: Fine, but ensure attestations are regenerated. Our attestation gate will block promotion for unsigned manifests. Also mark the retag as ephemeral in release metadata for auditing.

maria: Agreed. @security please monitor cosign audit during the retag. Change window open until 23:00 UTC.

sam: Running retag now. Commands:
```bash
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-ids imageTag=v2026.03.15 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-tag v2026.03.15-rc1 --image-manifest file://manifest.json --region eu-west-1
# then cosign sign and upload attestations
```

deploy-bot: manual trigger received for redwood/api:v2026.03.15-rc1 7: canary deploy started in eu-west-1 (status: in_progress)

security: I've started a quick verification of the cosign signatures once the new tag is available. Do not promote rc1 to the canonical tag until I ack.

sam: Canary passed. eu registry now resolves all blobs; re-signed manifest and pushed attestations.

maria: Kicking off the full rollout now. Deploybot main rollout triggered. Monitoring latency, error rates, and token-level cost dashboards.

deploy-bot: full rollout initiated. Auto-rollback configured to previous stable v2026.02.28 if errors exceed threshold. Will escalate to #incidents on >=5% error rate.

kai: Post-deploy action item: add a manifest parity pre-check in deploybot to validate destination blob availability before final tagging to avoid future cross-regional gaps.

jen: I'll write a brief entry in the release notes: "Temporary retag v2026.03.15-rc1 used to mitigate eu replication gap; no functional code changes. Original tag will be reclaimed after attestation." Also add changelog blurb.

maria: Closing the hold. Thanks team for the quick turnaround.
